data.text:
| set_variable_to_random | `var = `
The variable to modify or create.
`min = `
The minimum possible value, defaults to 0.
`max = `
The maximum possible value, defaults to 1.
`integer = `
Sets if the variable *must* be an integer or if it can be decimal. Defaults to false.
| *(example below)*`set_temp_variable_to_random = my_var` | Sets a variable's value to the specified amount, creating it if not defined. The result will be greater than or equal than the minimum and strictly less than the maximum. | Shortened version exists with `set_variable_to_random = `, setting it to a decimal between 0 and 1. Can be used in triggers. | |
